title: Commercial HR Administrator
description:
An established and growing manufacturing business are looking to recruit an organised and proactive Commercial HR Administrator to provide essential support across its HR and Commercial departments, on a 6 month fixed term contract.

Job Description for the Commercial HR Administrator role:

We are looking for an organised, proactive and detail-oriented Commercial HR Administrator to provide administrative support across both the Human Resources and Commercial functions. This is a varied role offering the opportunity to work alongside several departments and develop experience across HR, recruitment and commercial operations. Working closely with the HR team, the successful candidate will support the full employee lifecycle, alongside general commercial and office administration.
- Preparing and issuing offer letters, employment contracts and new starter documentation.
- Coordinating employee onboarding, inductions, probation administration and offboarding activities.
- Maintaining accurate and confidential employee records and updating HR systems.
- Supporting recruitment activities, including liaising with agencies, arranging interviews and communicating with candidates.
- Preparing interview documentation, recruitment packs and maintaining recruitment trackers.
- Raising purchase requisitions and purchase orders, processing goods receipts and assisting with invoice administration.
- Providing general administrative support to the Commercial, Purchasing and Sales teams.
- Organising meetings, booking travel and accommodation, preparing agendas and taking meeting minutes.
- Monitoring and ordering office supplies and liaising with external suppliers.
- Assisting with internal newsletters, employee communications, noticeboards and company events.
- Supporting HR projects and employee engagement initiatives as required.

Candidate Requirements for the Commercial HR Administrator role:
- Previous experience within a Business Administration, HR Administration or Commercial Administration role.
- Strong IT skills, particularly Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook and PowerPoint.
- Excellent organisational and time management skills.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills.
- High level of accuracy and attention to detail.
- Ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritise workloads effectively.
- Confident handling confidential information with discretion and professionalism.
- A proactive, flexible approach with the ability to work independently and as part of a team.
- Ability to learn new systems and processes quickly.

Desirable experience includes:
- CIPD Level 3 or NVQ Level 3 in Business Administration.
- Previous experience using HR systems.
- Experience with Time Escape.
- Experience raising purchase orders, goods receipting and processing invoices.
- Knowledge of SAP and/or Ariba.
- Previous recruitment, onboarding and employee administration experience.
- Experience producing reports, newsletters and internal communications.

This role would suit candidates with the following experience: HR Administrator, HR Assistant, HR Coordinator, Commercial Administrator, Business Administrator, Office Administrator, Recruitment Administrator or People Administrator.

This role is commutable from: Stoke-on-Trent, Newcastle-under-Lyme, Stone, Stafford, Cheadle, Blythe Bridge, Longton, Trentham, Fenton, Hanley and surrounding Staffordshire areas.

Hours: Monday Friday 9:00 am 5:00 pm Full-time or part-time
(minimum 3 days per week) 37.5 hours full-time / 22.5 hours part-time minimum

Salary: up to £30.000 Per Annum

Brampton Recruitment are an independent Commercial and Accounts & Finance recruitment agency working in partnership with employers spanning Stoke on Trent, Staffordshire, Cheshire, and the Greater Manchester region.

title: Internal Recruiter / Talent Acquisition
description:
An excellent opportunity has arisen for an experienced Internal Recruiter / Talent Acquisition Specialist to join a successful and growing Engineering / Logistics organisation supporting multiple sites across the UK.

This is a key role focused on end-to-end recruitment and talent attraction, working closely with hiring managers to attract and secure the best talent across the business.

As Internal Recruiter Talent Acquisition, you'll manage recruitment campaigns across multiple UK locations, developing sourcing strategies, building talent pipelines and improving recruitment processes. It's a varied role involving everything from candidate sourcing and stakeholder management to site visits and careers events.

Package:
- £35k - £40k
- Annual company Bonus Scheme
- Great company benefits

The Role

As Internal Recruiter Talent Acquisition, your responsibilities will include:
- Managing the full recruitment lifecycle from vacancy briefing through to offer and onboarding.
- Working closely with hiring managers to understand requirements and develop effective recruitment strategies.
- Sourcing candidates through job boards, LinkedIn, networking, referrals and direct recruitment campaigns.
- Building and maintaining talent pools for current and future vacancies.
- Coordinating interviews and supporting managers throughout the selection process.
- Managing and improving the company recruitment portal and applicant tracking system.
- Providing salary benchmarking and market insights to support recruitment decisions.
- Building relationships with managers and teams across multiple UK sites.
- Attending site visits, careers fairs and recruitment events to attract future talent.
- Monitoring recruitment activity and identifying opportunities to improve processes.

Role Requirements

We're looking for an experienced Internal Recruiter, Talent Acquisition Specialist, Recruitment Consultant or Resourcing Advisor with:
- Strong end-to-end recruitment experience.
- Experience managing multiple vacancies and recruitment campaigns.
- Excellent candidate sourcing skills, including LinkedIn and job boards.
- Confidence building relationships with hiring managers and senior stakeholders.
- Strong communication and organisational skills.
- Experience using applicant tracking systems or recruitment CRM platforms.

Experience within engineering, manufacturing, logistics, automation or other operational environments would be advantageous but is not essential.

Please apply for the role of Internal Recruiter Talent Acquisition or call Stuart Cooper for more information.

title: L&D Coordinator
description:

£30,000-£35,000 depending on experience
Full time - Hybrid working available

title: Recruitment Administrator
description:
Recruitment Administrator Office-based in Stoke on Trent Monday to Friday, 9:30am to 2:30pm (flexible) 15 per hour Structured hours with strong work-life balance in a busy recruitment environment

Meridian Business Support are looking to appoint a Recruitment Administrator to support day-to-day operations within a well established branch. This position plays a key part in ensuring payroll accuracy and smooth onboarding for a large candidate workforce.

As a Recruitment Administrator, you will be responsible for maintaining accurate records and delivering timely payroll processing within a fast-moving environment:
- Process weekly payroll, ensuring deadlines are consistently met
- Collate, check and verify timesheets with a high level of accuracy
- Calculate holiday pay, overtime, bonuses and adjustments using Excel and internal systems
- Maintain and update candidate records within the CRM system
- Enter new starters and ensure all personal and assignment data is recorded correctly
- Issue assignment details, contracts and relevant onboarding documentation to candidates
- Answer the phone, and responding to queries from both candidates and clients

To be successful in this Recruitment Administrator role, you will demonstrate:
- Excellent communication skills including via the phone and email
- Strong Excel skills, including confidence with calculations and data management
- Previous experience using CRM systems or recruitment databases
- Excellent attention to detail with a focus on accuracy and compliance
- Ability to manage high-volume administrative tasks and meet strict deadlines
- Experience within payroll, recruitment administration or a similar coordination role is desirable

Benefits and working environment
- 15 per hour
- Consistent weekday hours with no weekend work
- Office-based role offering structure and routine
- Supportive and collaborative team environment
- Possible Opportunity to develop within a growing recruitment business

If you are a detail-focused administrator looking for a busy and structured position where your organisational and Excel skills will be valued, this Recruitment Administrator position offers a stable and rewarding next step.

Meridian Business Support is a recruitment specialist acting on behalf of our client as an Employment Agency for this vacancy.

title: Remote HR Administrator
description:
HR Administrator
Remote

Monday to Friday - 37.5 hours per week

Permanent, Full Time

A well-established business is looking to appoint an experienced HR Administrator to join their HR team which is a fully remote opportunity with occasional visits to their office in Staffordshire.
You will be working closely with the Senior HR Administrator, you will support a wide range of HR activities across a group of companies within the food manufacturing sector. This is a hands-on role requiring excellent attention to detail, strong organisational skills and the ability to work independently whilst supporting the wider team.

The Role

HR Systems & Records: Maintain accurate employee records, HR databases and systems, ensuring all information is up to date, confidential and correctly stored.

Recruitment & Onboarding: Support recruitment administration, arrange interviews and manage new starter documentation, inductions and onboarding processes.

Payroll & Benefits: Assist with payroll administration, checking employee information, updating records and resolving any discrepancies.

Employee Relations: Provide administration support for performance management, disciplinary and grievance processes, ensuring all documentation is accurate.

Reporting & Compliance: Prepare HR reports, maintain compliance records and support internal and external audits in line with UK employment legislation and GDPR.

Employee Engagement: Support staff wellbeing initiatives, internal communications and employee engagement activities.

Process Improvements: Help improve HR systems, digital records and administration processes to ensure the department runs efficiently.

About You

HR Administration: Previous experience in HR administration or a similar role. You must be from a manufacturing, food or FMCG background.

Attention to Detail: Excellent attention to detail is essential, with the ability to maintain accurate records, identify errors and manage confidential information.

HR Systems: Confident using HR systems, Microsoft 365, Teams and Excel. Experience with payroll systems and applicant tracking systems (ATS) would be advantageous.

UK HR Knowledge: A good understanding of UK employment legislation, HR processes, GDPR and compliance requirements. A CIPD qualification is desirable.

Organised: Able to manage multiple tasks, prioritise workloads and meet deadlines whilst working independently.

Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work professionally with people at all levels of the business.

Approach: A proactive, hands-on attitude with strong problem-solving skills and a willingness to support the wider team.

Please apply TODAY to express an interest. A member of the Jelly Technical team will endeavour to contact all suitable applicants within 72 working hours.
